hypotheses.title: execution-id existence differential inside an agent the caller can already access
hypotheses.claim: arm_chat_report_back answers 404 for a missing/foreign row and 403 for a row the caller did not dispatch, so an accessor could tell which execution ids of that agent exist
hypotheses.verdict: not a finding: GET /api/agents/{name}/executions is accessor-scoped, so the ids are already readable by anyone who reaches this gate; the #186 self-uniform rule targets AGENT enumeration, which get_authorized_agent answers uniformly before this code runs. Hard exclusion 5 (hardening without a concrete vulnerability). Applied before merge: the dispatcher refusal is now the same uniform 404.
